interpretationNotes: S1 is a hit-rate item, not a speed item: these pilot hit counts (one sample per mode, two grids per cell) are small-n descriptions and carry no uncertainty guarantee; the gating numbers come from the frozen catalogue later
F0/F1 is the isolated S2 comparison, FC/FM/F1 the floor choices, FU/F1 the uniqueness filter, FS/F1 the reference-parent choice; the gains are correlated and are not multiplied as independent factors

phase A is not empty: it accepts many removals (the accepted counts are in the records and the per-pass table); what often comes out empty is the frontier LIST (every refused group proved ambiguous by the DFS), an anticipated failure mode of the route, and the DFS after every genuinely stuck floor test is the intended behaviour
the final phase A parent is omitted as a DECLARED PROTOTYPE RESTRICTION, not a theorem: S2 operational solvability is heuristic and canonical requiredness is the authority

K_F = 12 bounds the ATTEMPTED phase-B entries (phaseB tries); the allowed-set solves are only those attempts that passed the fresh uniqueness proof (and the FU filter); K_F = 12 and the 16 deepen proposals are acceptable prototype limits
unreached keys are unstarted/inconclusive: they are not zero-cost trials and not censored observations

acceptance.evidence: variant-manifest.json lists the eight modes with floors, S2, parent, filter, forks, budgets and every interpretation; nothing is adopted silently

every frontier record carries floor tests by rung, DFS entries/checks, ladder passes, phaseB solves, deepen proposals and verification solves; refused-test DFS is in the per-phase cost (phaseA includes it)
every document says provisional (pre-freeze); no variant, S1 or bank decision is made
frontier-test.cjs: pure cases (fake engine) and the engine cases of the first command: every floor solve asserts assumeUniqueness false; FU enables it only after the fresh DFS proof of that candidate
S2 is the Rederived signal (never a solved report or a rating); the audit compares ordinals (0 correctness problems)
reference hashes and the immutable snapshot hashes are recorded per phaseB try and checked; a fresh bounded count precedes every reference candidate
every dimension is charged; a stop is outcome sample-budget with the dimension; the hooks and the solution are restored (unit and engine cases)
budgets-r2.json: the fixed rule; cells fitted: mega16, samurai, classic9, mega12; unfitted (pilot ceilings kept): none
0 false exact flags, 0 error records, 0 audit correctness problems
